newsitem.title: INDIA: Delhi shares close lower on heavy selling.
newsitem.headline: Delhi shares close lower on heavy selling.

text.p: Delhi shares closed sharply lower on heavy selling by foreign institutional investors, mainly attributed to poor half-year results of some weighted companies, brokers said.
The Delhi bourse's benchmark index fell 13.38 points, or two percent, to close at 662.78 at the end of two-week settlement.
"The market was flooded with sellers and it was difficult to find buyers even at lower prices," Sumit Gandhi, of brokers Rare Financial Services, said.
"Buyers were not ready to take risks, fearing a further fall in prices," he said.
TELCO was down 32 rupees, or eight percent, to 343. ACC lost 16.25 rupees to 1,134.90.
TISCO fell 2.80 rupees to 154.95 and Reliance Industries dropped 1.10 to 177.50. ITC was quoted 5.20 rupees lower at 273.30, while State Bank of India fell 2.30 rupees to 216.20.
Hindustan Lever lost five rupees at 803.
